name: IWSLT TED Talks (WIT3)
description: Transcribed and translated TED talk subtitles via WIT3/FBK. 109 languages, spoken/presentation domain. NOT used for evaluation due to CC-BY-NC-ND 4.0 license — the NonCommercial clause restricts commercial benchmarking and the NoDerivatives clause limits redistribution. The official download server (wit3.fbk.eu) is also frequently unreliable.
quarantineReason: type:reference catalogue card — already excluded from every registry by build_registry (reference cards emit no entries). Marked quarantine:true as belt-and-suspenders defense-in-depth: CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0 (NonCommercial + NoDerivatives) means it must never enter a commercial, prize, or runnable lane, matching the EdTeKLA quarantine convention.

source.citation: Cettolo et al. (2012). WIT3: Web Inventory of Transcribed and Translated Talks.

license.notes: NonCommercial and NoDerivatives clauses prevent use in commercial benchmarking and redistribution. Inherited from TED Conferences' content licensing.

usageRestrictions.evaluation: restricted — NC clause prevents commercial benchmarking
usageRestrictions.communityNotes: wit3.fbk.eu download server is frequently offline. HuggingFace mirror (IWSLT/ted_talks_iwslt) is more reliable but inherits the same license.

_provenance.populatedFrom: IWSLT/WIT3 documentation, HuggingFace dataset card, license analysis
_provenance.reason_excluded: CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0 license: NonCommercial clause restricts commercial use of benchmark scores; NoDerivatives clause limits redistribution; unstable download server.
